data.narrative:
Dimensional Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Tobias Hanrath, Jason Salfi, David Erickson, and Clayton D. Poppe. The company has raised $25.4M to date. The valuation landscape for Series A frontier-tech companies in Climate & Energy consists of 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis, the only applicable triangulation method, uses total capital raised as a proxy base ($25.4M) and applies a typical Series A to subsequent-stage multiplier of 2.0x, yielding an implied valuation of $50.8M. This method is appropriate given the target's current stage and absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers in the narrow Climate & Energy cohort. While 8 same-sector comparables exist, none met the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints across same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters, making peer-median triangulation unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $43M (low) to $58M (high), centered on a median of $50.8M. Key uncertainties include the company's unit economics, revenue trajectory, and technical differentiation relative to the sparse public and private peer set. The single-method triangulation constrains analytical confidence; additional data on Dimensional Energy's burn rate, customer commitments, or technology maturity would strengthen valuation precision.
